supersession_scope: Inferential priority only. Sampling frame, tissue/HPLC protocol, anchor geometry, timing, eligibility and both pre-frozen model formulas remain unchanged.

decisive_primary.estimand: within-node centered anchor TNC coefficient for future same-meter Thalassia Braun-Blanquet after baseline same-meter state and node fixed effects
decisive_primary.reason: Controls stable transect identity and current local above-ground state; a cross-node reserve association alone can be generated by persistent site quality.
decisive_primary.support_rule: two-sided 95% bootstrap interval entirely above zero
decisive_primary.replication_gate: >=36 complete three-anchor nodes total and >=6 per bay

supportive_network_test.estimand: four-bay cross-node baseline TNC coefficient for future focal-frequency change after baseline state and water body
supportive_network_test.rule: A positive network-scale association cannot rescue an unsupported decisive within-node primary.

interpretation_matrix.within_node_supported__network_supported: Strongest state-augmentation result: local reserve state predicts future local divergence and also transports across the four-bay network.
interpretation_matrix.within_node_supported__network_unsupport: Local state augmentation supported; network-average transportability is unresolved/weak.
interpretation_matrix.within_node_unsupported__network_support: Report network-scale reserve prediction as supportive only; do not claim decisive state augmentation because stable/local site-template alternatives remain.
interpretation_matrix.within_node_unsupported__network_unsuppo: Primary TNC reserve mechanism unsupported at the designed effect scale; move to independently frozen physical/community mechanisms without retuning TNC.
interpretation_matrix.within_node_nonestimable: TNC state-augmentation question remains unresolved; network result may be described but is not promoted to decisive evidence.

no_post_outcome_changes: Do not swap decisive and supportive roles after future outcome access.
Do not replace future same-meter Braun-Blanquet with binary reappearance.
Do not use the cross-node result to rescue an unsupported within-node primary.
Do not move or replace failed anchors after TNC assay or future outcome access.
